targets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original 2D ART-DIRECTION TARGET illustration for SternenBuergerchen, a readable isometric sci-fi strategy game. The attached InselKrieg island illustration is STYLE reference only: transfer its richly illustrated miniature-world quality, clean precise primary forms, matte painted broad colors, warm sun and cool shadows, functional clustered everyday details; do not copy its island, old aircraft, sea or historical architecture. Subject: a broad beautiful rust-red and warm ochre alien highland, stratified eroded mesas, large angular rock formations grounded naturally, pale dusty basin with a winding service track and deliberately open navigable routes. One compact frontier outpost with ivory and muted slate-teal modular habitat, workshop with open working bay, a raised landing pad with simple small utilitarian shuttle, connected footpaths, service pipes, solar array and water tanks; several tiny naturally proportioned suited crew give scale and activity. Dry sage plants in small meaningful clusters, occasional grounded boulders. Composition landscape 16:9, elevated 3/4 isometric camera, scene fills frame, farther mesas and pale turquoise atmospheric sky, bright midday clarity, long readable planes, believable human-door scale. The ground should be warm LIGHT stone/terracotta and the structures distinguishable; quiet empty space is intentional. Detailed high-quality painterly game illustration, sharply readable silhouettes, no photorealistic texture grit, no toy plastic, no dense uniform scattering, no night darkness, no neon cyan grid, no text, no logos, no UI, no borders. This is an authored 2D target, not a runtime screenshot.
